title: Optimized CTAB RNA Extraction from Rhizosphere for Metatranscriptomics
author: Kipa Tamrakar
materials: Add the following reagents to each sample: 600 µL water-saturated phenol 400 µL 500 mM NaP buffer, pH 5.8 200 µL Chloroform: Isoamyl alcohol (49:1) Set water bath at 60°C and place tube containing CTAB extraction buffer. 200 µL pre-heated CTAB extraction buffer 10 µL 14.3 M 2-Mercaptoethanol Vortex to mix

RiboFree Universal Depletion ZYMOseq Ribo-depletion Cycle Following cDNA synthesis, transfer sample tubes from Step 37 to ice and add 10 µL of Depletion Reagent 1 for a total of 30 µL. Mix thoroughly by pipetting and spin down. Return sample tubes to the thermal cycler and run PreDepletion Incubation program (Stage 1-3); see detail settings in Table above. Do not remove the tube from the thermal cycler at the 68ºC hold of Stage 3. Add 10 µL of Depletion Reagent 2 to the tube in the thermocycler. Mix thoroughly by pipetting. Close the thermal cycler lid and continue Depletion Reaction program (Step 4); see detail settings in Table above DO NOT remove the tube from the thermal cycler at the Stage 5 hold. Add 10 µL of Depletion Reagent 3 to each sample tube in the thermocycler. Mix thoroughly by pipetting. Close the thermal cycler lid and continue through Stop Depletion (Stage 6-7). Add 2 µL of Depletion Reagent 4 to each sample tube. Quickly remove the tube from the thermal cycler and gently flick to mix. Spin down briefly to collect the reaction. Immediately return the tube to the thermal cycler to continue and continue through Depletion Cleanup program (Stage 8-10). Remove the tube from the thermal cycler and spin down. Add 26 µL of 95% ethanol to the sample for a total of 78 µL. Mix thoroughly by pipetting. Add 156 µL of Select-a-Size MagBeads to the tubes and incubate at room temperature for 5mins. Pellet the beads by placing the tubes on a magnetic stand. Wash the beads with 200ul of Zymo-Seq Wash Buffer. Repeat the washing step. Remove the tube from the magnetic stand. Spin down and place back on the magnetic stand. Without disturbing the pellet, aspirate any residual Zymo-Seq Wash Buffer. Air dry all sample pellets while tubes remain on the magnetic stand Resuspend the beads in 11 µL of DNA Elution Buffer and transfer the tube to the thermal cycler to complete DNA Elution program (Stage 11-12). Remove the tube from the thermal cycler, collect sample by centrifugation and place each tube on the magnetic stand to elute. Transfer 10 µL of the eluate Air dry all sample pellets while tubes remain on the magnetic standto a new 0.2 mL PCR tube. STOP POINT: Purified cDNA can be safely stored at -20°C short term until proceeding to next step in the process.

steps.title: Prepare bead beating tubes
steps.instruction: Add 950 mg of 0.1 mm silica beads and 50 mg of 0.5 mm silica beads to each 2 mL screw‑capped tube.

steps.title: Add rhizosphere sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 250 mg of rhizosphere into a clean weigh boat and transfer the material to the prepared bead‑beating tube.

steps.title: Pre‑chill on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Bead‑beating homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize with a Mini‑Beadbeater (Biospec, Cat# 112011) in two cycles of 3.5 × 1000 strokes min⁻¹ for 40 s each, inserting a 1‑minute ice cooling step between cycles.

steps.title: Vortex mixing cycles
steps.instruction: Perform one vortex cycle of 20 s vortex/40 s ice, then two cycles of 10 s vortex/30 s ice.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and transfer the aqueous phase to a new 2 mL micro‑fuge tube.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 4.6), vortex to mix, and incubate on ice for 3 min.

steps.title: Phenol extraction
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL water‑saturated phenol, vortex to mix, and incubate on ice for 3 min. Samples may be stored on ice for a few hours.

steps.title: First chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (49:1), pulse‑vortex until a milky solution forms, and incubate on ice for 3 min.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, then transfer ~800 µL of the aqueous phase to a new 2 mL micro‑fuge tube.

steps.title: Move to clean area
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube again at 10 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C in an RNase‑decontaminated clean area.

steps.title: Second chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (49:1), pulse‑vortex until milky, and incubate on ice for 3 min.

steps.title: Bind RNA to column
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL RNA binding buffer to each 50 µL total RNA sample and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation on column
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL absolute ethanol and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Wash column – RNA Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 30 s at room temperature, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column – RNA Prep Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL RNA Prep Buffer, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 30 s at room temperature, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: On‑column DNase I treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare ZYMO DNase Mix by gentle inversion, add 40 µL to the column matrix, and incubate at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Post‑DNase wash
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 30 s at room temperature, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 30 s at room temperature and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Transfer to IC column
steps.instruction: Transfer 300 µL of the eluate to a Zymo‑Spin IC Column placed in a collection tube.

steps.title: Final column wash and transfer
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min at room temperature, discard flow‑through, and move the column to a RNase‑free 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Elute purified RNA
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL DNase/RNase‑free water directly to the column matrix, incubate 1 min, then centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 30 s at room temperature; collect the eluate.

steps.title: Quantify RNA (Qubit)
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration using 1 µL of each purified sample with the Qubit RNA HS kit (ThermoFisher, Cat# Q33238).

steps.title: Assess RNA purity (Nanodrop)
steps.instruction: Measure RNA purity using 1.5 µL of each sample on a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (ThermoFisher, Cat# ND‑ONE‑W).

steps.title: Check RNA integrity
steps.instruction: Confirm RNA is intact (no degradation) with an Agilent Tapestation (Cat# G2992AA) using 1 µL of each sample.

steps.title: cDNA synthesis – first step
steps.instruction: Transfer 250 ng RNA to a clean PCR tube, adjust volume to 8 µL with nuclease‑free water, add 2 µL cDNA Synthesis Reagent 1 (total 10 µL), mix, spin, and run the Primer Annealing program (Stage 1‑2) as specified in the protocol table.

steps.title: cDNA synthesis – second step
steps.instruction: During the 4 °C hold of Stage 2, add 10 µL cDNA Synthesis Reagent 2, mix, spin, then resume the Reverse Transcription program (Stage 3‑5) as detailed in the table. Proceed directly to ribosomal RNA depletion.

steps.title: Adapter ligation – preparation
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat a thermal cycler to 98 °C (lid 105 °C). On ice, combine the components listed in the Adapter Ligation Table in a 0.2 mL PCR tube, mix, and spin down.

substeps.instruction: Return to ice for ≥2 min; set cycler to 37 °C (lid 50 °C) for the next step.

steps.title: Adapter ligation – master mix
steps.instruction: Vortex the Adapter Ligation Master Mix for 30 s before use, then add the listed components on ice as per the table.

substeps.instruction: Vortex Adapter Ligation Mix 2 for 1 min, spin, and incubate at 37 °C (lid 45 °C) for 1 h.

steps.title: Adapter ligation – cleanup
steps.instruction: At room temperature add 85 µL DNA Elution Buffer, mix, then add 48.6 µL Select‑a‑Size MagBeads and incubate 5 min. Pellet beads on a magnetic stand, wash twice with 200 µL ZymoSeq Wash Buffer, aspirate residual buffer, air‑dry beads, resuspend in 16 µL DNA Elution Buffer, spin, incubate 1 min, place on magnetic stand, and transfer 15 µL eluate to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube.

steps.title: Library amplification – PCR
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Zymo‑Seq UDI primers to the 15 µL adapter‑ligated eluate (total 25 µL), mix, then add 25 µL Amplification PreMix (total 50 µL), mix, spin, and run the ZYMOseq Library Amplification Cycle as specified.

steps.title: Library amplification – bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Spin down the PCR product, add 50 µL DNA Elution Buffer, then add 80 µL Select‑a‑Size MagBeads, mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on magnetic stand, discard supernatant, remove from stand, add 100 µL DNA Elution Buffer, mix, add 80 µL Library Binding Solution, mix, incubate 5 min, pellet beads, wash twice with 200 µL ZymoSeq Wash Buffer, aspirate residual, air‑dry beads, resuspend in 21 µL DNA Elution Buffer, spin, incubate 1 min, place on magnetic stand, transfer 20 µL eluate to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube.

steps.title: Quantify final library
steps.instruction: Use 1 µL of each library with a Qubit DNA HS kit assay; store libraries at ≤4 °C overnight or ≤‑20 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation – first spin
steps.instruction: Add 1500 µL 70 % ice‑cold ethanol to the sample, centrifuge at 20 000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min, discard ethanol and retain the pellet.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation – second spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the pellet at 20 000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Cold incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on an ice bath in a 4 °C refrigerator for 20 min.

steps.title: PEG‑NaCl precipitation
steps.instruction: Add one volume of PEG‑NaCl precipitation buffer and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Air‑dry and resuspend
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet under a laminar hood (≤15 min total drying) and resuspend in 50 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Briefly minifuge to collect any remaining ethanol and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store RNA samples at ‑80 °C until further use or proceed directly to the next step.

steps.title: Final aqueous phase transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase into a new 1.5 mL micro‑fuge tube.
